This version of 8403 is one of my more recent MOCs built from my own brick-stock. The house is built with a 32x32 baseplate, 8x16 plates for the house and a redesigned dormer and third floor. I eliminated the double wall in the third floor and expanded each of the details in the house.

You'll probably notice a mix of bley and old light grey, as well as some yellowed white bricks... I intentionally included a mix of really new and older bricks to give the appearance of weathering and staining.
